normalization_fit: Only WT rep1 unannotated training background windows; per-window O/E mean cancels contact amplitude
shape_score_units: Standardized log reconstruction error conditional on training-background coarse counts
noise_control: Decreasing isotonic conditional mean plus 5 training-count bins of robust residual scale; no validation/test fit
threshold_rule: Largest noise-adjusted shape-score threshold reaching 90% center recall on classification-training known structures only
repeat_correlation: Pearson of untransformed O/E upper triangle k>=2; distance expectation from WT rep1 training backgrounds
limitations: unannotated training background may contain unknown structures
classifier probability is closed-set resemblance, not a calibrated novelty score
conditional null assumes Poisson-like count sparsity effects are monotone; empirical validation remains necessary
threshold calibrated on training labels; held-out recall reported separately
absence of annotations plus reproducibility does not confirm biological novelty
